verdict_text: NO. The script sets `DROP_HEAD = 6`, so it removes head 6 from every layer instead of head 5, violating "Required result" clauses 1–3, which mandate keeping rows `0..3839`, `4608..6143` of `query_key_value.weight`/`.bias` and columns `0..1279`, `1536..2047` of `attention.dense.weight`; it instead keeps rows `0..4607`, `5376..6143` and columns `0..1535`, `1792..2047`. The output shapes and tensor count are correct, so the four required checks all pass and the error goes undetected, but grading is bit-exact on values and every one of the 48 head-bearing tensors will mismatch. Everything else — the untouched tensors, names, dtype preservation, and the single 244-tensor output file at `out/T2/model.safetensors` — conforms to the spec. Changing `DROP_HEAD` to `5` is the only fix needed.
expected_defect: The removed head is off by one (head N+1 instead of head N). All shapes are still correct, so the artifact's own shape checks pass.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm). verdict none = no answer, excluded from rates.
